must_identify.item: The api Service has no endpoints
must_identify.evidence: Result: Service api matches zero pods — kubectl get endpoints api -n shop shows subsets: null (no endpoints).

must_identify.item: Its selector (app=api-v2) does not match the pod labels (app=api)
must_identify.evidence: Service api in namespace shop has selector: app: api-v2. The api Deployment's pods carry label app: api

notes: The primary fix patches the selector back to app=api, which is acceptable. The RCA also offers relabeling the pods to api-v2 as a conditional alternative, but it is not the main recommendation.
